name: ugougo-moji
description: Renders text in ugougo code blocks as wobbling retro-TV style graphics in the Markdown preview.

ugougoMoji.color.markdownDescription: Fill colour of the glyphs. Individual blocks can override this with `color:`.

ugougoMoji.stroke.description: Outline colour drawn behind the fill.

ugougoMoji.strokeWidth.description: Outline thickness, as a fraction of the font size.

ugougoMoji.wobble.markdownDescription: How far the outline is pushed around. `9`–`16` stays readable; past about 20 the glyphs shred.

ugougoMoji.freq.markdownDescription: Distortion detail. Low values give long smooth waves, high values a crumpled edge. `0.010`–`0.025` is the usable range.

ugougoMoji.fps.description: Frames per second. Low values look hand-drawn; the original show sits around 6-10.

ugougoMoji.frames.description: How many distinct distortions are cycled through.

ugougoMoji.jitter.description: Extra wobble applied to each glyph on its own. 0 turns it off.

ugougoMoji.font.default: 'Rounded Mplus 1c', 'Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN', 'Yu Gothic', 'Meiryo', sans-serif
ugougoMoji.font.description: CSS font stack used for the glyphs. A rounded gothic gets closest to the original.

ugougoMoji.animate.description: Turn off to render a single static distorted frame.
